name: Material Variance by Project
query:
SELECT
  p.name AS "Project:Link/Project:200",
  p.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
  p.service_team AS "Team:Link/Service Team:150",
  IFNULL(p.total_planned_material_cost, 0) AS "Planned Material Cost:Currency:160",
  IFNULL(p.total_actual_material_cost, 0) AS "Actual Material Cost:Currency:160",
  (IFNULL(p.total_planned_material_cost, 0) - IFNULL(p.total_actual_material_cost, 0)) AS "Variance:Currency:150"
FROM `tabProject` p
WHERE p.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(service_region)s = '' OR p.service_region = %(service_region)s)
  AND (%(customer)s = '' OR p.customer = %(customer)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s = '' OR p.expected_start_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s = '' OR p.expected_start_date <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY (IFNULL(p.total_planned_material_cost, 0) - IFNULL(p.total_actual_material_cost, 0)) ASC
